chunks: King of the Day of Judgement.
ai.seo_question: What does 'Malik of the Day of Judgement' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Malik' (Sovereign) is distinguished from 'Malik' (King) to denote absolute, inherent authority rather than delegated power, particularly emphasized during the Day of Judgment. This title underscores the dual nature of divine governance, where God’s sovereignty is fully realized in the Hereafter, reinforcing the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) and the ultimate accountability of all creation under His exclusive rule.
